reason: A searchable GitHub-backed plugin marketplace with settings tabs and agent tools for discovering, installing, updating, enabling, disabling, and uninstalling third-party plugins.

summaries.zh: 这是一个将 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题同步为可搜索插件市场的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，支持浏览、安装、更新、启用、停用和卸载第三方插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the GitHub dsh-plugin topic into a searchable marketplace for browsing, installing, updating, enabling, disabling, and uninstalling third-party plugins.

capabilities: Searches and paginates GitHub repositories under the dsh-plugin topic
Installs, updates, enables, disables, and uninstalls third-party plugins
Registers agent tools for marketplace search and plugin management
Runs package-manager and Git-based installation tasks
Uses GitHub and npm metadata for plugin discovery and version checks
